title: Stable Dimensionality Reduction via Isometric Centroid-Encoder
abstract: arXiv:2610.33872v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many supervised dimensionality reduction methods promote intra-class compactness and inter-class separation but do not explicitly constrain class geometry, leading to variability in the relative arrangement of classes across independent runs. Such variability limits the reproducibility and interpretability of low-dimensional embeddings. We propose the Isometric Centroid-Encoder (ICE), a supervised dimensionality reduction framework in which class centroids are learned directly in the latent space while preserving a prescribed pairwise class-centroid geometry. Unlike existing centroid- or prototype-based methods that primarily encourage intra-class compactness, ICE explicitly regularizes the relative arrangement of latent class centroids. translated_title: 通过等距质心编码器实现稳定的降维
translated_abstract: 许多监督降维方法促进了类内紧凑性和类间分离性，但没有显式约束类别的几何结构，导致在独立运行中各类别之间的相对排列存在变异性。这种变异性限制了低维嵌入的可复现性和可解释性。我们提出了等距质心编码器，这是一种监督降维框架，其中类别质心直接在潜空间中学习，同时保持预设的成对类别质心几何结构。与现有的主要促进类内紧凑性的基于质心或原型的方法不同，ICE 显式地对潜空间中类别质心的相对排列进行正则化。与保留样本级关系的多维缩放以及许多度量学习方法不同，ICE 作用于类别质心，在无需大量……（原文截断）的情况下保持类间几何结构。
tldr: 提出等距质心编码器（ICE），通过在潜空间中直接学习类别质心并显式正则化其成对几何排列，解决了传统监督降维方法因不约束类几何结构导致的可复现性问题，实现稳定可解释的低维嵌入。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Isometric Centroid-Encoder (ICE), a supervised dimensionality reduction framework that learns class centroids directly in the latent space while explicitly regularizing their prescribed pairwise geometry, achieving stable and reproducible low-dimensional embeddings.
